_readme: One entry per band scan video, newest anywhere. Each scan gets its own page at /band-scans/<slug>/, and every station in its tracklist also appears on that station's page and frequency page.
Required: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and at least one track with khz. Everything else is optional but makes the page better.
video: paste the YouTube link as-is (youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtu.be/..., or youtube.com/shorts/...).
time_utc: when you recorded it, e.g. 03:10. upload_date: the day you posted it to YouTube (defaults to date).
tracks: t = where the station starts in the video (m:ss), station = name as you know it (matched to the schedule automatically), khz, sinpo, note.
If a station name isn't recognised it still shows, just without a link. The build log prints a warning for anything it skips.

_example.title: Lower band scan: Radio Rebelde, WRMI, WWCR, Radio Poland
